description: Check whether a complete Rotase project can satisfy opening hours, staffing requirements, availability, rest rules and work-hour limits. Use after rotase_validate_project and before generation when the user asks whether a schedule is possible. This operation is read-only and does not save or modify the project.

inputSchema.description: The complete Rotase project object. Use the object returned as the "project" field by rotase_examples as a template. Required top-level sections are project, store and employees; availability, preferences, monthlyTargets and schedules may be empty arrays when unused.

name: rotase_check_feasibility

outputSchema.description: Operation-specific Rotase result. Read the returned content and structuredContent fields; validation and feasibility results may contain violations, shortages or explanatory messages.

title: Check schedule feasibility
